dedupe_keys.name: camber croatia dc1 roadlab outputs road condition

description: The RoadLAB collection describes laser-scanned lanes and road corridors, CRG surface models and road-condition indicators for Croatian roads DC1, DC3 and DC29. Most full descriptions identify an October 2025 campaign and LAZ, CRG or text outputs. Condition fields include chainage, coordinates, time, roughness, profile statistics, crossfall and rut-depth measures. Twelve native deposits are grouped as products from the same named survey, preserving each road and product identity. Two lane deposits have empty descriptions, so their dates and detailed formats are not inferred from neighbours. Access is restricted, observation counts and route extent are unknown, and no independent sample counts are summed. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
